derivation: Mechanically derived: parent decisions carried across, renamed headers resolved via the perturbation log. No new judgement.

rationales.ref: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Internal product reference, unique per colour and size variant, so it identifies the individual product.
rationales.LABEL: Renamed from 'label' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Display name of the product; the CDM has no product name field.
rationales.description: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Free text product description; not a controlled category, so productCategory does not fit.
rationales.note_public: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Free text commercial note about finishing and packing; no matching CDM field.
rationales.FK PRODUCT TYPE: Renamed from 'fk_product_type' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Dolibarr flag separating physical products (0) from services (1); ERP internal.
rationales.tosell: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. ERP flag marking the item as sellable; not passport data.
rationales.tobuy: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. ERP flag marking the item as purchasable; not passport data.
rationales.tobatch: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Dolibarr setting that turns on lot or serial tracking; it holds no batch number value, so batchNumber does not apply.
rationales.barcode: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. 13 digit barcode values with EAN-13 structure (confirmed by fk_barcode_type = 2), which is a GTIN-13.
rationales.fk_barcode_type: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Dolibarr code for the barcode symbology (2 = EAN13); describes the barcode format, not product data.
rationales.customcd: Renamed from 'customcode' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Customs tariff code; 61091000 is the HS heading for cotton T-shirts.
rationales.fk_country: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. In the Dolibarr product table this foreign key is the product's country of origin. It holds a numeric Dolibarr country id that must be resolved to a country name or code on conversion.
rationales.weig: Renamed from 'weight' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. Weight of the product itself (0.18 kg per tee), used with weight_units.
rationales.length: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Physical dimension of the item; CDM size is a garment size label, not a measurement.
rationales.width: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Physical dimension of the item; CDM size is a garment size label, not a measurement.
rationales.height: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Physical dimension of the item; CDM size is a garment size label, not a measurement.
rationales.price: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Selling price; commercial data outside the passport scope.
rationales.tva_tx: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. VAT rate; accounting data outside the passport scope.
rationales.cost_price: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Purchase cost; commercial data outside the passport scope.
rationales.ACCOUNTANCY CODE SELL: Renamed from 'accountancy_code_sell' by the perturbation; a header rename does not change column contents, so the parent decision stands. General ledger account for sales; accounting data.
rationales.desiredstock: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Target stock level for inventory planning; not passport data.
rationales.datec: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Timestamp of when the ERP record was created, not the date the garment was produced, so productionDate does not apply.
rationales.options_composition: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Fibre content of the garment (100% Cotton).
rationales.options_colour: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Colour of the garment variant.
rationales.options_size: Unchanged from parent heldout_h2_dolibarr. Size of the garment variant.
